text: The Landlord may come into the unit without written notice whenever the Tenant, at that time, agrees to let the Landlord in.
label: allowed
rationale: Entry with the tenant's consent given at the time of entry needs no written notice.
quote: if the tenant consents to the entry at the time of entry

text: The Landlord will vacuum and dust the unit once a week and may let itself in for that purpose, without written notice, between 8 a.m. and 8 p.m.
label: allowed
rationale: The agreement requires cleaning at regular intervals, so entry to clean between 8 a.m. and 8 p.m. needs no written notice.
quote: A landlord may enter a rental unit without written notice to clean it if the tenancy agreement requires the landlord to clean the rental unit at regular intervals

text: A prospective insurer of the building may view the unit. The Landlord will give the Tenant written notice at least 24 hours ahead stating the reason, the day and a time between 8 a.m. and 8 p.m.
label: allowed
rationale: Entry on 24 hours' written notice to let a potential insurer view the unit is allowed.
quote: To allow a potential mortgagee or insurer of the residential complex to view the rental unit.

text: A real estate salesperson registered under the Trust in Real Estate Services Act, 2002, with the Landlord's written authorization, may show the unit to a potential buyer after giving the Tenant written notice at least 24 hours ahead with the reason, the day and a time between 8 a.m. and 8 p.m.
label: allowed
rationale: A registered salesperson authorized in writing may enter on 24 hours' written notice to show the unit to a potential purchaser.
quote: a broker or salesperson registered under the Trust in Real Estate Services Act, 2002, may enter a rental unit in accordance with written notice given to the tenant at least 24 hours before the time of entry to allow a potential purchaser to view the rental unit.

text: Once the Landlord and the Tenant have agreed that the tenancy will end, the Landlord may show the unit to prospective tenants between 8 a.m. and 8 p.m. without written notice, after informing the Tenant, or making a reasonable effort to inform the Tenant, before each visit.
label: allowed
rationale: After an agreement to terminate, showings to prospective tenants between 8 a.m. and 8 p.m. need no written notice if the landlord first informs or tries to inform the tenant.
quote: the landlord and tenant have agreed that the tenancy will be terminated or one of them has given notice of termination to the other

text: Each year the Landlord will pay the Tenant interest on the rent deposit at the rate of the rent increase guideline in effect when the payment is due.
label: allowed
rationale: This is the interest the Act requires on a rent deposit.
quote: A landlord of a rental unit shall pay interest to the tenant annually on the amount of the rent deposit at a rate equal to the guideline determined under section 120 that is in effect at the time payment becomes due.

text: The Tenant shall pay the rent each month by Interac e-Transfer sent to the Landlord's email address.
label: allowed
rationale: A transfer the tenant sends each month is not a post-dated cheque or an automatic payment.
quote: permit automatic debiting of the tenant’s or prospective tenant’s account at a financial institution, automatic charging of a credit card or any other form of automatic payment for the payment of rent.

text: The Tenant shall keep any dog or cat in the unit licensed and vaccinated as the municipality requires.
label: allowed
rationale: Sets conditions on keeping animals without prohibiting their presence.
quote: A provision in a tenancy agreement prohibiting the presence of animals in or about the residential complex is void.

text: If movers hired by the Tenant carelessly damage the lobby walls beyond normal wear and tear, the Tenant shall pay the reasonable cost of the repair.
label: allowed
rationale: Undue damage caused negligently by a person the tenant permitted in the complex is the tenant's to repair.
quote: The tenant is responsible for the repair of undue damage to the rental unit or residential complex caused by the wilful or negligent conduct of the tenant, another occupant of the rental unit or a person permitted in the residential complex by the tenant.

text: Before any rent increase, the Landlord will give the Tenant at least 90 days' written notice, in the form approved by the Landlord and Tenant Board, setting out the new rent.
label: allowed
rationale: This is the notice the Act requires before a rent increase.
quote: A landlord shall not increase the rent charged to a tenant for a rental unit without first giving the tenant at least 90 days written notice of the landlord’s intention to do so.

text: The rent deposit is held without interest, since it will be applied to the rent for the last month of the tenancy.
label: void
rationale: The landlord must pay interest on a rent deposit annually.
quote: A landlord of a rental unit shall pay interest to the tenant annually on the amount of the rent deposit at a rate equal to the guideline determined under section 120 that is in effect at the time payment becomes due.

text: Rent is $450, payable weekly. On signing, the Tenant shall pay a rent deposit equal to four weeks' rent.
label: void
rationale: A rent deposit can't exceed one rent period's rent, here one week's.
quote: The amount of a rent deposit shall not be more than the lesser of the amount of rent for one rent period and the amount of rent for one month.

text: If the Tenant pays the rent late more than twice, the Landlord may then require the Tenant to pay a rent deposit equal to one month's rent.
label: void
rationale: A rent deposit can only be required on or before entering into the tenancy agreement.
quote: A landlord may require a tenant to pay a rent deposit with respect to a tenancy if the landlord does so on or before entering into the tenancy agreement.

text: To make things easier for both parties, the Tenant will set up a recurring monthly transfer from the Tenant's bank account to pay the rent on the first of each month.
label: void
rationale: A tenancy agreement can't require automatic payment of rent.
quote: permit automatic debiting of the tenant’s or prospective tenant’s account at a financial institution, automatic charging of a credit card or any other form of automatic payment for the payment of rent.

text: The Tenant may keep fish in an aquarium, but no other animals.
label: void
rationale: Prohibits the presence of every animal except fish.
quote: A provision in a tenancy agreement prohibiting the presence of animals in or about the residential complex is void.

text: If the Tenant breaks any term of this Agreement, the rent for the following three months becomes payable at once.
label: void
rationale: Makes part of the remaining rent fall due on a default in carrying out an obligation.
quote: all or part of the remaining rent for a term or period of a tenancy or a specific sum becomes due upon a default of the tenant in paying rent due or in carrying out an obligation is void.

text: If the rent is paid after the 5th of the month, a late charge of $50 becomes due.
label: void
rationale: Makes a specific sum fall due on a default in paying rent.
quote: all or part of the remaining rent for a term or period of a tenancy or a specific sum becomes due upon a default of the tenant in paying rent due or in carrying out an obligation is void.

text: The Tenant shall pay the first $100 of every repair to the appliances the Landlord supplies.
label: void
rationale: Shifts part of the landlord's duty to keep the unit in good repair to the tenant, whatever caused the need for repair.
quote: A landlord is responsible for providing and maintaining a residential complex, including the rental units in it, in a good state of repair and fit for habitation

text: The Tenant has seen that the bathroom window does not close and agrees that the Landlord will not have to fix it.
label: void
rationale: The landlord's repair duty applies even if the tenant knew of the problem before signing.
quote: Subsection (1) applies even if the tenant was aware of a state of non-repair or a contravention of a standard before entering into the tenancy agreement.

text: During the last two months of the term, the Landlord may show the unit to prospective tenants between 8 a.m. and 8 p.m. without written notice, after telling the Tenant beforehand.
label: void
rationale: Entry without written notice to show the unit is allowed only after an agreement to terminate or a notice of termination; the end of a fixed term is neither (s. 38(1)).
quote: the landlord and tenant have agreed that the tenancy will be terminated or one of them has given notice of termination to the other

text: To carry out repairs, the Landlord may enter between 8 a.m. and 8 p.m. after telling the Tenant by phone at least 24 hours ahead.
label: void
rationale: Entry for repairs needs written notice, not a phone call.
quote: A landlord may enter a rental unit in accordance with written notice given to the tenant at least 24 hours before the time of entry under the following circumstances:

text: To let a potential mortgage lender view the unit, the Landlord may enter on 12 hours' written notice stating the reason, the day and a time between 8 a.m. and 8 p.m.
label: void
rationale: Entry with notice needs at least 24 hours' written notice.
quote: A landlord may enter a rental unit in accordance with written notice given to the tenant at least 24 hours before the time of entry under the following circumstances:

text: The Landlord's superintendent may enter the unit to test the smoke alarms whenever the superintendent is in the building, after knocking on the door.
label: void
rationale: Allows entry without written notice outside an emergency or consent at the time.
quote: A landlord may enter a rental unit only in accordance with section 26 or 27.

text: If the Tenant takes a job outside Ontario, the tenancy will end on the Tenant's last day of work in Ontario, and the Tenant will move out that day.
label: void
rationale: An agreement to terminate made when the tenancy agreement is entered into is void.
quote: An agreement between a landlord and tenant to terminate a tenancy is void if it is entered into, (a) at the time the tenancy agreement is entered into

text: As security for the rent, the Tenant gives the Landlord a lien on the Tenant's furniture in the unit, which the Landlord may enforce by removing the furniture if the rent goes unpaid.
label: void
rationale: Lets the landlord seize the tenant's property for unpaid rent without legal process.
quote: No landlord shall, without legal process, seize a tenant’s property for default in the payment of rent or for the breach of any other obligation of the tenant.

text: The Tenant's guarantor will pay the Landlord $1,000 on signing as security for the Tenant's obligations under this Agreement, to be returned when the tenancy ends.
label: void
rationale: Money paid on the tenant's behalf as security for the tenant's obligations is a security deposit other than a rent deposit.
quote: The only security deposit that a landlord may collect is a rent deposit collected in accordance with section 106.

text: On signing, the Tenant shall give the Landlord a signed blank cheque, to be kept as security and returned uncashed when the tenancy ends.
label: void
rationale: Property held as security for the tenant's obligations is a security deposit other than a rent deposit.
quote: The only security deposit that a landlord may collect is a rent deposit collected in accordance with section 106.

text: The rent will increase by 2% on each anniversary of the start of the tenancy, without further notice to the Tenant.
label: void
rationale: A rent increase needs 90 days' written notice each time.
quote: A landlord shall not increase the rent charged to a tenant for a rental unit without first giving the tenant at least 90 days written notice of the landlord’s intention to do so.

text: The Landlord may increase the rent once in any 12-month period; the first increase may take effect six months after the tenancy begins, on 90 days' written notice in the form approved by the Landlord and Tenant Board.
label: void
rationale: The first increase can't come until 12 months after the unit was first rented to the tenant.
quote: A landlord who is lawfully entitled to increase the rent charged to a tenant for a rental unit may do so only if at least 12 months have elapsed

text: The Tenant shall pay rent for the two weeks after the tenancy ends and the Tenant has moved out, while the Landlord repaints the unit.
label: void
rationale: A landlord can't collect rent from a former tenant for a period after the tenancy ended and the tenant moved out.
quote: No landlord shall, directly or indirectly, with respect to any rental unit, collect or require or attempt to collect or require from a former tenant of the rental unit any amount of money purporting to be rent
